closed_children.title: lernie binary: 'prompt' subcommand — commit the exchange

description:
Milestone per ARCHITECTURE.md §12.

Success criterion (quoted): A single prompt is sent to a provider endpoint, the response is written to disk, and is visible in the conversation repo as a commit. No git branching, no tools, no invocations.

=== Scope ===
- lernie binary with two subcommands: 'new' (create conversation repo from template) and 'prompt' (run one exchange).
- Anthropic messages-API client, non-streaming, auth from env var per providers.yaml.
- One exchange = one commit on the conversation repo's main. This is v0.1's explicit exception to the ARCH §2.3 branch invariant (branching arrives in v0.2).

=== Explicit non-goals ===
- Git branching, merges, compaction (v0.2).
- Tool use (v0.3).
- Invocations / subagents (v0.4).
- UI, streaming reprompt, workflow config, task suite (v0.5+).

=== Done-when ===
End-to-end demo:
  lernie new /tmp/c
  lernie prompt /tmp/c 'hello'
produces a commit in /tmp/c whose tree contains the assistant response.

=== Dependencies ===
- bl-5bbc: config schemas (need providers.yaml + agents.yaml loadable).
- bl-c91c: conversation repo template (need the on-disk skeleton to copy).
